Legal Requirement: Alcoholic beverage means a beverage... containing more than 0.5 per cent. abv... ethanol shall be of agricultural origin.
Description (Simple English): Alcoholic drinks (>0.5% ABV) must derive ethanol from agricultural sources.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regs
Remarks: Limit is zero for Alcohol-free beer.

Legal Requirement: Flavored beverages having more than 0.5 and up to 15.0% of alcohol by volume... with or without carbonation.
Description (Simple English): RTD alcoholic beverages must contain 0.5% to 15% ABV and meet specific parameters.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regs

Legal Requirement: Breast milk substitute product based on milk... to meet the nutritional requirements of infant during the first six months.
Description (Simple English): Infant formula is strictly defined as a milk substitute for the first 6 months.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Foods for Infant Nutrition) Regs

Legal Requirement: No person shall manufacture or sell Ayurveda Aahara intended for administration to infants up to the age of twenty-four months.
Description (Simple English): Ayurveda Aahara cannot be sold or manufactured for infants under 2 years old.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahara) Regulations

Legal Requirement: The viable number of added probiotic organisms in food shall be >= 10^8 CFU in the recommended serving size per day.
Description (Simple English): Probiotics must deliver at least 100 million CFU per daily serving.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Health Supplements...) Regs

Legal Requirement: Distilled spirits shall conform to Table 1: Residue on evaporation max 2.0%, Lead max 0.2 mg/l, Copper max 5.0 mg/l...
Description (Simple English): Distilled liquors must meet strict chemical purity and heavy metal ceilings.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regs

Legal Requirement: No person shall add vitamins, minerals and amino acids to Ayurveda Aahara
Description (Simple English): Synthetic vitamins, minerals, and amino acids are banned from being added to Ayurveda Aahara.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahara) Regulations

Legal Requirement: The food business operator shall maintain the food distribution records... for a period of one year from best before date...
Description (Simple English): FBOs must keep distribution records for at least 1 year past expiry for recall purposes.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Food Recall Procedure) Regs

Legal Requirement: FBOs selling or catering food on school campus shall ensure compliance to Schedule 4, Food Safety Display Board and Food Safety Supervisor...
Description (Simple English): School caterers/canteens must have FSSAI licenses, display boards, and trained supervisors.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Safe food for children...) Regs

Legal Requirement: The quantity of sample of food to be sent to the Food Analyst... shall be as specified (e.g., Milk: 500ml, Water: 3L).
Description (Simple English): Exact physical quantities must be drawn for statutory lab testing.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Lab & Sample Analysis) Regs

Legal Requirement: Every package of Non-Vegetarian Food... shall bear a brown triangle... Vegetarian Food... green circle... size based on Principal Display Panel.
Description (Simple English): Retail packs must display the green/brown dot logo in exact dimensions.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regs

Legal Requirement: Every package of vegan foods, after the approval, shall carry the logo as specified... (VEGAN with V-leaf).
Description (Simple English): Approved Vegan foods must prominently display the green Vegan V-leaf logo.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Vegan Foods) Amendment Regs

Legal Requirement: Nutritional Information per 100g or 100ml... energy, Protein, Carbohydrate, Total Sugars, added sugars, Total fat, saturated fat, trans fat...
Description (Simple English): Packages must declare a full nutrient breakdown per 100g/ml and per serving.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regs

Legal Requirement: There shall be a statutory warning... 'CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOL IS INJURIOUS TO HEALTH. BE SAFE-DONT DRINK AND DRIVE.'
Description (Simple English): Alcohol containers must carry the specific statutory health warning.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regs

Legal Requirement: Every label... shall specify 'AYURVEDA AAHARA' and the logo... an advisory warning 'ONLY FOR DIETARY USE'.
Description (Simple English): Ayurveda Aahara must display its specific logo and dietary use warning.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahara) Regulations

Legal Requirement: All packaging materials of plastic origin shall pass the prescribed overall migration limit of 60mg/kg or 10mg/dm2...
Description (Simple English): Food contact plastics must pass chemical leaching tests.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations

Legal Requirement: Drinking Water shall be packed in colourless, transparent and tamper-proof bottles... transparency not less than 85 percent.
Description (Simple English): Water bottles must be clear (>=85% light transmission) and tamper-proof.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations

Legal Requirement: Food Products in which edible oils and fats are used... shall not contain industrial trans fatty acids more than 2% by mass...
Description (Simple English): Industrial trans fats are strictly limited to 2% of total fat.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition/Restriction) Regs

Legal Requirement: For fish oils, the Maximum level (ML) of inorganic arsenic (As-in) that is 0.1 mg/kg will be applicable.
Description (Simple English): Fish oils must not contain inorganic arsenic over 0.1 ppm.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Contaminants & Toxins) Regs

Legal Requirement: No person shall sell... fruits which have been artificially ripened by use of acetylene gas, commonly known as carbide gas.
Description (Simple English): Carbide gas ripening is banned (Ethylene gas up to 100ppm allowed).
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition/Restriction) Regs

Legal Requirement: No person shall commence any food business unless he possesses a valid license...
Description (Simple English): Every commercial food operator must hold an active FSSAI License/Registration.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing & Registration) Regs

Legal Requirement: No person shall import any article of food without an import license... Food Importer shall register with DGFT and possess valid IEC.
Description (Simple English): Importers need a Central FSSAI License and DGFT IEC.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Import) Regulations

Legal Requirement: The custom shall not clear any article of food unless it has a valid shelf life of not less than sixty per cent or three months before expiry...
Description (Simple English): Imported foods must have at least 60% or 3 months shelf life remaining.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Import) Regulations

Legal Requirement: No person shall advertise or market or sell... food products high in saturated fat or trans-fat or added sugar or sodium in school campus or... within fifty meters...
Description (Simple English): HFSS foods cannot be sold or advertised within 50 meters of a school.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Safe food for children) Regs

Legal Requirement: Provisions of regulations 5(4)... shall not apply in respect of mineral water, packaged drinking water, carbonated water, alcoholic beverages, liquid milk, milk powders and honey.
Description (Simple English): Water, plain alcohol, milk, and honey are exempt from Veg/Non-Veg logos.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regs

Legal Requirement: Where the surface area of the package is not more than 100 square centimetres, the label... shall be exempted from the requirements of list of ingredients...
Description (Simple English): Packages <100 cm² do not need ingredient lists/nutrition panels on the primary unit.
Applicable Regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regs
